Document the Damage:
Take photos of the damaged packaging itself, especially if it shows potential product damage
Take clear photos of the entire product and close-ups of the affected areas
Include a common object near the damaged area to show scale
If the item has a law tag with a barcode, photograph both the front and back
Contact Our Support Team:
Email the photos and a description of the damage to support@avocadomattress.com
Include your order details, email, and current shipping address for faster processing
The team will guide you through the next steps based on your documentation
What to Expect:
You should receive a confirmation email within 12-72 hours after reporting the damage
Processing time for replacement requests may take up to 7 business days (not including any production time needed to make the item)
If the item needs to be returned, you'll receive a prepaid return shipping label
If there's an issue caused by our manufacturing or logistics teams, you can qualify for a replacement instead of needing to return or refund the impacted item.
